question: Write the expression for magnifying power of a simple microscope when the final image is formed at the least distance of distinct vision. Explain the terms used.

options.A: $m=\dfrac{D}{f}$, where $D$ is the focal length and $f$ is the least distance of distinct vision.
options.B: $m=1+\dfrac{f}{D}$, where $f$ is the focal length and $D$ is the aperture.
options.C: For a simple microscope with final image at the least distance of distinct vision, $m=1+\dfrac{D}{f}$, where $D$ is the least distance of distinct vision and $f$ is the focal length of the convex lens. A smaller $f$ gives greater magnifying power.
options.D: $m=\dfrac{f}{D}$, where $D$ is the diameter of the lens.
